reason: In src/sentry/search/events/datasets/discover.py:1041-1052, SnQLFunction("upsampled_count", ...) omits private=True (defaulting to False), so BaseQueryBuilder.resolve_function (src/sentry/search/events/builder/base.py:737-738) and DiscoverFunction.is_accessible (src/sentry/search/events/fields.py:1515-1534) allow any caller to invoke upsampled_count() directly without functions_acl, bypassing the allowlist and error-query checks in src/sentry/api/helpers/error_upsampling.py:13-140. Because DiscoverQueryBuilder.load_config (src/sentry/search/events/builder/discover.py:65-71) uses DiscoverDatasetConfig for Discover, Transactions, Events, and IssuePlatform, this exposes a query emitting Column("sample_weight") on datasets that do not have that column.
